Live bus connection

Live Bus needs an address to listen to. The staging bus is node tools/mockbus.js --replay scenarios/hurricane.json --loop, which serves ws://localhost:8787. A page opened from a hosted link cannot reach a WebSocket at all, so for live, open dist/som-dashboard.html from disk.

Arrows on, ripples and dots off. The transmit pair is true of any message on the bus; the inferred pair is drawn from this page's own config, since nothing on a SOM bus records who read anything.
The dashboard subscribes and renders. It publishes nothing. In live mode the replay transport is disabled and every arriving envelope is rendered through the same path as replay.

      SKILLS 0 the library skills this demo reads
      A skill is a markdown file.

      It's just files and folders. A standards editor can read one on a train, argue with a paragraph in a meeting and change that paragraph, and nothing needs redeploying, because nothing was deployed.

      Three things, one word
      LIBRARY SKILL
      generic and shared. One file, published once, the same for everybody, carrying no editorial judgement at all. These are the ones listed below.
      NEWSROOM POLICY
      your configured instance of that file: which field matters, which value matters, who is senior enough to clear it. Every editorial decision lives here. It is yours, it is not public, and no vendor needs a copy to work for you.
      VENDOR SKILL
      a declaration of conduct: what a vendor serves, what it reads, what it does when a policy resolves to it, and what it does when it doesn't, which is nothing.

      Skills declare, executors act. The only thing that ever acts is a vendor's own software, at its own edge. Give a skill the ability to act and you have made software, with an owner, a version you must be on and a price, and the governance layer belongs to whoever runs it.
